description:
This 3ABN Today Bible Q&A tackles some of Scripture’s toughest questions: Why does Judges 11 mention a human sacrifice? Should new members be rebaptized? Will families be reunited in Heaven? Who is the woman in Revelation 12? We’ll also explore baptism, prophecy, Lot’s choices, visions, and more—finding clear, Bible-based answers for life and faith.
￼￼
￼Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
￼￼￼

1. Everything I have learned tells me that God abhors human sacrifice. First and foremost, it directly violates the commandment, “Thou shalt not kill.” Even more, it contradicts His instructions regarding acceptable sacrifices for the atonement of sin. Yet, Judges 11:30–40 recounts a story of what appears to be a human sacrifice that God accepts. How can this be? What was its purpose, and is there a lesson for us in this account?  Why does Judges 11:30–40 depict a human sacrifice if God forbids it? 

2.  When Jesus was on earth, He had His disciples, and John the Baptist also had his own followers. After Jesus’ ascension, many who had been baptized by John chose to be rebaptized under Jesus’ baptism. Based on this, why do Seventh-day Adventist churches accept members from other denominations without requiring rebaptism?   Should new members be rebaptized? 

3.  Can you please explain 1 Corinthians 5? 

4.  Is it proper to baptize 6-year-old children?  

5. Why was God going to kill Moses in Exodus 4:24-26?

6.  If in Heaven there will be no more families, why do we comfort those who have lost a loved one by saying they will be reunited with their spouse, children, or parents? Will the family unit truly be restored? Will the family unit be restored in Heaven?

7. Can you explain the difference between the Gift of Prophecy and the Spirit of Prophecy? 

8. Why didn’t Lot go back to Abraham when he fled from Sodom? He asked the angels to let him go to Zoar, after which he went to the mountains. His daughters then decided they wanted kids. Would they not have found husbands among Abraham's servants? 

9.  Can you explain 1 Samuel 19:9?  Does God have an evil spirit? 

10.  How can you tell if a vision or message is from God or Satan?  

11. Were all animals created from the dust like humans?  

12.  Revelation 12:5 describes a woman giving birth to a male child while the dragon waits to destroy him. I understand that the male child represents Jesus Christ and the dragon represents Satan. I always thought the woman symbolized Israel, but I recently learned that my church teaches the woman represents the Church. How can the Church give birth to Christ when it was Christ who gave birth to the Church?   Who does the woman in Revelation 12 symbolize?
